findings.observation: Stacked cardboard boxes are sitting inside the marked pedestrian walkway.
findings.evidence: The boxes overlap the yellow floor line and cover most of the walkway width.
findings.recommendation: Move the boxes to a designated storage area and keep the walkway clear.

findings.observation: A pallet jack appears to be parked in the aisle.
findings.evidence: The jack's handle and forks extend into the travel path with no operator nearby.
findings.recommendation: Return the pallet jack to its parking spot when not in use.

findings.observation: Loose plastic wrap is lying near the edge of the walkway.
findings.evidence: A pile of clear film is visible on the floor beside the walkway line.
findings.recommendation: Dispose of the wrap so it can't become a trip or slip hazard.
